title: Register name gets inserted into current buffer with vim-peekaboo in Neovim 0.4.2

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

- `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: 8.0.1365) behaves differently? Yes
- Operating system/version: macOS 10.14.6
- Terminal name/version: alacritty 0.3.3 (cc3e4d3)
- `$TERM`: xterm-256color

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

I did this with `nvim -u NONE`, that's probably basically the same?

```
nvim -u NONE
:packadd vim-peekaboo
:call peekaboo#on()

type some words in buffer, spread however you like over at least 4 lines (see screenshots in comment below to see how I set up my test buffer)
viw to select one of the words, then "+y to yank
```

### Actual behaviour

Register name gets inserted into buffer and is highlighted with `peekabooSelected` group.

### Expected behaviour

Register name should not be inserted into buffer and should not be highlighted.

It seems like the actions that should happen in the peekaboo buffer are instead happening in my current working buffer and I don't know why. See https://github.com/junegunn/vim-peekaboo/issues/61 for screenshots and more description. I'm filing this here because it doesn't happen on Vim, and I don't remember it happening before I upgraded to Neovim 0.4.2.
